title: kit.fa-rules.v1
description: A Persian rule pack for `kit check persian` (@saasreport/fa-lint, docs/PERSIAN.md): lexicon classes and rules. Every rule carries the examples that must fail and must pass; the tests run both sets, so a correction recorded here can never ship twice. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions (flags gu) over one text segment; {{name}} expands to a class (an alternation, longest first), {{<}} / {{>}} are Persian word boundaries and {{fa}} is one Persian letter.

pack.description: The pack's name (kit: the kit's own pack; a project names its own).

version.description: Raised whenever a rule is added or changed.

classes.description: Lexicon classes, by name: the words a {{name}} token stands for. A project's persian.config.json adds words to a class or defines new ones (e.g. brand).

exampleClasses.description: Words the examples assume for classes a project supplies (e.g. a brand), used only when the examples run as tests.

id.description: Stable id, cited in findings and allow-list entries.

ownerId.description: The id the owner's correction list gives this rule (e.g. FA-BI-CALQUE), kept so a future correction is traceable to it.

layer.description: typography: characters, spacing, ZWNJ, digits, bidi; wording: calques and word choice; grammar: word order and government; glossary: one concept, one word.

on.description: raw: the text as written (typography); normalized: after the normalizer (Persian ی/ک and digits, ZWNJ in compounds, spacing), so a rule is written once for every spelling.

unless.description: A pattern tested, anchored, on the text right after the match: when it matches, the finding is dropped (e.g. a verb follows, so the phrase is a sentence, not a calqued compound).

unlessBefore.description: A pattern tested on the text right before the match (anchored at its end): when it matches, the finding is dropped.

fix.description: The suggested fix: a replacement for the match ($& and $1…$9 are the match and its groups; empty deletes it), or advice in words when the fix needs a person (then autofix is false).

autofix.description: The fix is a safe mechanical replacement; `kit persian fix --write` applies it.

kind.description: owner-correction: the owner corrected this text; proofread: a recorded proofreading change list; constitution: a kit constitutional rule; style-guide: general Persian orthography (e.g. the Academy's guide, Virastar).

ref.description: Which correction: a date and place, a change-list row, a document section.

before.description: The text as it shipped (must also be a fail example).

after.description: The owner's corrected text (must also be a pass example).

severity.description: Every rule is an error. There is no warning level (docs/CONSTITUTION.md, t=0): a rule that cannot be made precise is removed, an instance a reviewer read goes in persian.config.json allow.

registers.description: Where the rule applies: written copy, spoken scripts (podcasts, colloquial), or both (default).

fail.description: Each must produce this rule's finding.

pass.description: Each must produce no finding of this rule.
